title: SG-4.1.3 · Replace Phaser 4-only APIs with 3.90 equivalents in the Phaser modules
summary: BootScene, config, createGame, events and PhaserHost use only Phaser 3.90 APIs, proven by mocked unit tests
description: Context: package.json pins phaser ~3.90.0. The files game/frontend/src/phaser/BootScene.ts, config.ts, createGame.ts, events.ts and game/frontend/src/components/PhaserHost.tsx were read. They use Phaser.AUTO, Phaser.Scale.FIT, Phaser.Scale.CENTER_BOTH, render.pixelArt/roundPixels/antialias, Phaser.Scenes.Events.SHUTDOWN, game.scale.refresh() and game.destroy(true). All of these exist in 3.90. No Phaser 4-only API was found. Desired behavior: the audit is recorded as the code stays on 3.90-only APIs, and mocked unit tests fail if a Phaser 4-only API is introduced. Why: Phaser is pinned to 3.90 and Phaser 4-only APIs would break at runtime.
acceptance_criteria: Given the five files, when they are scanned, then none references a Phaser 4-only API such as Phaser.Renderer.WebGL.Renderer.Filters, Phaser.GameObjects.Filters or the setFilter/enableFilters family.
Given buildGameConfig with a mocked phaser module, when called, then it returns the 3.90 config shape (type AUTO, 640x360, pixelArt, roundPixels, FIT scaling).
Given BootScene and PhaserHost with phaser mocked, when mounted and unmounted, then only 3.90 methods are called (events.once, scale.refresh, destroy(true)) and the scene unsubscribes on shutdown.

out_of_scope: Changing the package.json or lockfile pin

technical_constraints: Tests use vitest with phaser mocked and no browser
definition_of_done: Each requirement has Act and Verify units completed
